## Highlights

- **Dolby audio configuration:** Added dedicated speaker layout and decoding mode settings for Dolby Digital audio.
- **Enhanced interface experience:** Added three optional background styles, selectable application color themes, improved settings navigation and optional interface sound effects.
- **Streaming improvements:** Added decoder mode and connection encryption details to streaming diagnostics and the host negotiation screen, refined stream transitions, and updated upstream Moonlight components including Opus 1.6.1.
- **Navigation and settings fixes:** Improved independent scrolling in the settings panel, focus visibility and circular navigation in host and application lists.
- **HDR codec switching:** Fixed HDR setting state handling when switching between H.264 and HDR-compatible codecs (HEVC and AV1).
